name: Scars of the Soul
description:
About This Game

The game's progression is driven by the storyline, with a semi-linear, semi-open exploration style. Find the most suitable exploration route in your own way, featuring Souls-like combat and light exploration puzzles.

Main Features:

• Explore in your own way:

The world is vast and boundless, perfect for exploration. It is made up of more than ten regions, and there are many shortcuts connecting these regions. When a path seems too tricky, try unlocking new abilities and solving puzzles that link multiple regions.

• Rich and varied combat:

Over 20 thrilling boss battles and more than 30 types of regular enemies

Create a style that suits you. By collecting soul orbs and different weapons, you can build a setup that fits you, which can be used to defeat powerful enemies and explore the world.

• Crafting and Upgrading:

      During your journey, you will discover various soul orbs and weapons. Soul orbs can be used individually, stacked, or combined to build powerful playstyles to enhance your character's abilities. Weapons can be improved through crafting and enhancement to boost their base stats and special attack effects.

• Your choice is particularly important:

      The 'Echoes of the Void' had an instinctive craving for energy, which became his only 'guidance' for moving forward. It would lead him to areas rich in void energy—areas that were often the places where he had fought in the past or key battlefields of the 'War of the Twin Kings.' Every time he reached such a location and came into contact with residual energy or specific items, it would trigger flashes of his shattered memories. Is the 'Echoes of the Void' truly pure evil? As the story progresses, the protagonist may discover that this will is actually a fragment of the otherworldly core he had 'absorbed' back then. It is not solely intent on destruction, but aims to 'reshape' the world through Altos, or to 'return home.' From its dimensional perspective, its logic may, in fact, be reasonable.

• Highly replayable:

       After developing the main story, 'Soul Claw Marks' will add a roguelike mode featuring consecutive boss battles for players to experience.
short_desc: The two countries went to war, unleashing forbidden powers. Years later, monsters ravage the land. The protagonist awakens, battles the monsters, explores the world, uncovers the truth of the past, and seeks to recover lost memories—a lonely journey of wandering and struggling against oneself.
